subject.title: [Refactor] Consolidate synthetic log formats across MCP service pipelines

question: Should these two MCP launchers intentionally expose one stable fatal-diagnostic format, or should each owner retain independent launcher text?
rationale: The duplication is mechanically removable, but deciding that the outputs are one contract changes the ownership boundary established by the Codex harness refactor and cannot be inferred from current docs or tests.

options.title: Define a shared diagnostic contract
options.body: Approve a minimal owner-neutral formatter with focused tests proving the fields and rendering both launchers must share.

options.title: Keep owner-local formatting
options.body: Treat the similarity as incidental and close the cleanup request without creating a cross-owner abstraction.

recommendation.title: Define a shared diagnostic contract
recommendation.body: Approve a minimal owner-neutral formatter with focused tests proving the fields and rendering both launchers must share.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is the merged refactor that established the current Codex extension and harness ownership boundary.
